overview: Iteration 2: Complete DB-backed settings migration. Move operating-hours, time-slots, and chat-settings from JSON files to the Neon Postgres site_settings table (reusing the key/JSONB schema from Iteration 1). All getter/setter functions become async. Update every caller. Zero JSON filesystem reads at runtime — Vercel-safe.
goals: Migrate readOperatingHours/writeOperatingHours to async DB-backed (site_settings key: 'operating_hours')
Migrate readTimeSlots/writeTimeSlots to async DB-backed (site_settings key: 'time_slots')
Migrate readChatSettings/writeChatSettings to async DB-backed (site_settings key: 'chat')
Update all callers across route handlers and RSC pages to await the new async functions
Add a seed verification script and update Vercel deployment notes
Zero fs.readFileSync/writeFileSync calls for config at runtime after this iteration
